trigger: The 19-block raw AR(1) fit reported high serial correlation despite sub-0.1-percent density fluctuations and negligible fitted drift.

added_outputs: AR(1) variance inflation relative to independent blocks

interpretation: Serial correlation materially increases uncertainty relative to the naive independent-block estimate, but the density-mean uncertainty remains below 0.02 percent. Eight-cycle batch means substantially reduce residual lag correlation and give stable order-0.01-percent standard errors. Four 16-cycle batches are too few for a reliable correlation estimate.

problem_classification.remedy: Report autocorrelation-aware and multiscale batch uncertainty instead of treating four-cycle blocks as independent or relying on AR(1) effective count alone.

histogram_boundary: The external eduPIC EEPF and IFED files discard raw observation counts, so their pooling uncertainty cannot be repaired after execution. AuroraPIC's native phase-EEDF path already retains macro and represented observation counts; external IFED remains descriptive until count-preserving source output is available.
claim_boundary: This post-hoc diagnostic does not alter the predeclared 64-cycle failure or the active 96-cycle extension rule, and it does not establish physical validation.
